comment: Default reference voices. The npm package does not carry the wav files: egatari tts downloads them from url (the files at a release tag of this repository) on first use, checks each against sha256 and keeps them in the user's cache folder (tts/refvoices.py). A checkout uses tts/voices/ directly. When a voice changes, set tag to a tag that has the new file and update its sha256 (tools/test-tts-voices.mjs checks that they match tts/voices/).
